description: A genuinely silent source. Absence lands as evidence_absent with all typed slots null — never as a low score, never as a string sentinel in a numeric column.
instruction:
Extract the following from the landed product datasheet text.

unit_weight_grams: shipping weight of one unit in grams, as an integer.

warranty_months: length of the manufacturer warranty in months, as an integer.

certification: the safety certification the datasheet names, exactly as
written.

Cite the verbatim span each value rests on. If the datasheet does not state a
field, return the absent sentinel for that field and cite nothing. An honest
absence is always preferred to an inferred value: do not derive a warranty
length from an industry norm, and do not read a weight off a similar product.

target_fields.name: unit_weight_grams
target_fields.description: Shipping weight of one unit, grams.

target_fields.name: warranty_months
target_fields.description: Warranty length in months. Optional — many datasheets are silent, and silence is a finding, not a fault.
